color.description: Black, red, green, blue, orange, purple, teal, gray.

fill.description: Fill palette index for rect, ellipse, diamond, triangle, and star; -1 is transparent.

text.description: UTF-8, at most 65536 bytes. Newlines allowed; other control characters are not.

points.description: Absolute world-coordinate [x,y] pairs for pen and highlight strokes.

id.description: add_items only: a name that later items in the same batch can use in from/to.

label.description: add_items only, for rect, ellipse, diamond, triangle, and star: black text centered on the shape. It becomes a separate text item placed right after the shape.

label_size.description: Text size of the label, like a text item's width (7 px per unit).

from.description: For line and arrow: link the start to this item, given as a board index, or in add_items also the id of an earlier item in the batch. A linked end stops just outside the item's bounding box and follows the item when it moves or resizes. Coordinates for a linked end are optional and are recomputed. get_board reports links as board indices.

to.description: Link the end of the line or arrow to this item; see from.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Discover the active tab's board (path is null for an Untitled tab), the tab count, collaboration toggle, human revision, busy state, and agent status. Available even when collaboration is off.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Inspect the board, current revision, viewport, and items in back-to-front order. Item indices can change after edits: use this revision for update/delete/undo/redo. Coordinates are world units: screen = world * zoom + pan; the panel occupies the left 168 screen pixels. Paginate using next_offset and verify the revision stays the same.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Append up to 1000 items in paint order as one undo step. Returns their indices, their bounds [x0, y0, x1, y1], and the new revision. Defaults: black stroke, width 3, no fill. Text size is width * 7. Shapes can carry a centered label, and lines or arrows can link to items with from/to instead of coordinates; linked ends follow the items. An invalid item names its position and the reason, and nothing changes. Does not save automatically; call save_board when finished.

revision.description: Optional expected revision. Supply with collaboration_epoch when responding to a snapshot.

collaboration_epoch.description: Reject the response if collaboration was toggled since the snapshot.

tools.name: update_items
tools.description: Replace items at the supplied indices, atomically as one undo step. Supply COMPLETE item definitions, not patches. Use the revision from get_board or the last edit; stale revisions are rejected. Indices must be unique. Moving or resizing an item moves the line and arrow ends linked to it. Give from/to again to keep a replaced connector linked.

tools.name: delete_items
tools.description: Delete the listed unique indices as one undo step. Requires the current revision. Remaining indices shift, so inspect the board again afterwards. Line and arrow ends linked to a deleted item stay where they are, unlinked.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo one action from the shared human/agent history. Requires the current revision.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo one action from the shared human/agent history. Requires the current revision.

tools.name: save_board
tools.description: Atomically save the active tab. Pass path (absolute, or relative to the server's directory) to save under a new name, as Save As does; an Untitled tab needs it. Refuses a path that another tab has open.

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Set pan and zoom to frame the live canvas before export. All three values are required. Does not alter board items or undo history.

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Write a PNG beside the active tab's board file and return its path and an image preview (up to 32 MiB). With a window it shows the visible canvas; set_view frames it. Headless, it shows every item, fitted. The tab needs a file; call save_board with a path first.

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Write an SVG of every item, fitted, beside the active tab's board file and return its path. Needs no OpenGL, so it works headless without an EGL driver. Text embeds the canvas font. The tab needs a file; call save_board with a path first.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.description: Read an image of the active tab without writing a file. With a window it shows the visible canvas; headless, it shows every item, fitted. Returns revision and collaboration epoch with the image. Requires Collaborate on.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List the open tabs: index, path (null when Untitled), active, unsaved changes, and item count. Other tools act on the active tab.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make another tab active. This changes the revision, so read the board again before editing.

tools.name: new_board
tools.description: Open a new Untitled tab and make it active. Save it with save_board and a path.

tools.name: open_board
tools.description: Open a board file in a new tab and make it active. A missing file starts an empty board with that path. An open file switches to its tab.

path.description: Absolute, or relative to the server's directory.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab. A tab with unsaved changes is refused unless discard is true.

tools.name: measure_text
tools.description: Measure text in world units before you place it, to size boxes and center labels. Works without Collaborate.
